_comment: Phase manifest for the Talent One headless runner, matching the 2.x shape that agents/relay.md runs inside a session: (1) scout builds the Context Pack, critic reviews it; (2) every requested artifact agent runs in parallel against the pack, each writing content/<NN>.content.json; (2.5) critic per artifact; (3) deterministic render + verify with skills/talent-one/scripts/render.py; (4) qa-gate over the package when 2 or more artifacts were built. There is no inter-artifact dependency: `pack_paths` is each artifact's CONTEXT_PACK.md section 5 row (required paths; `research:` entries live in pack-research.json), which the runner preflights before spawning and tools/check_dag.py keeps in step with the reference. Models and tools come from each agent file's frontmatter (stamped by function-core's compile.py), so tiers follow MODULE.yaml. JSON on purpose: stdlib parse only.
